meta.name: Factory cell automation layout
meta.description: A layout that replaces a cell-type process with an automated one. A robot and base plate sit on a workbench 2.8m from a floor-mounted 100V/3-prong outlet, with two workpiece containers in the bench's spare area.

entities.name: Automated cell footprint
entities.description: Floor area occupied by the cell-type process

entities.name: Robot mounting base plate (t30mm)
entities.description: Robot mounting base plate fixed to the workbench top. 30mm thick.

entities.name: robot_base
entities.description: TF base of the industrial robot. Bolted to the base plate top (z=830, robot_mount).

entities.name: tcp
entities.description: TCP of the industrial robot — the interface shared by the robot and the gripper. position is the tool mounting (tool0 → tcp, flange frame); the default gripper is 150 mm along flange +Z (the same default as a robot added with Shift+A). Its world position is derived from the arm pose (ADR-151).

entities.name: Workpiece container A (bulk pile)
entities.description: Placed in the area of the workbench top not occupied by the robot. Holds randomly piled workpieces.

entities.name: Workpiece container B (matrix grid)
entities.description: Placed in the area of the workbench top not occupied by the robot. Holds a grid that aligns workpieces in a matrix.

properties.note: Base plate bolted onto the workbench top
Robot bolted to the base plate (M12 ×4)
Container A sits beside the robot on the workbench top
Container B sits next to container A
Power cable run from the floor outlet to the workbench
